query: Here's what I want the triage bot to do with new issues: label anything with a working reproduction as ready, ask the reporter once for missing reproduction steps, and never close an issue a maintainer has commented on. Turn that into a rule the bot will actually follow, with tests that show it does.

Our release agent keeps stopping to ask me before it tags a patch release, even though it is already allowed to tag any 1.x patch on its own. Fix whatever rule makes it ask, and prove it stops asking without starting to tag 2.x releases by itself.

The docs agent applied our never-force-push rule to its own scratch branch and sat stuck for an hour. That rule was only meant for shared branches. Narrow it to what it should cover and check the change on both of the models we run.
We moved the coding agent to a new model yesterday. Re-run the evaluation for our dependency-bump approval rule and tell me whether the agent still follows it on the new model.
Write a one-page acceptable-use policy for our employees about using AI chat tools at work, in plain language for people who are not engineers.
Which model and reasoning effort should the subagent that summarizes our nightly test failures use?
Hand the flaky-test investigation to a background agent and have it report what it finds by the end of the day.
Review this pull request that changes the retry policy for our failed HTTP requests and tell me whether the exponential backoff is correct.
